access.definition: Login, signup, password or account access

subtopics.access.login: Cannot log in or sign in, login errors, verification codes or emails not arriving, login loops
subtopics.access.logout: Unexpectedly logged out, app keeps signing the user out
subtopics.access.account: Account recovery, lost/locked/deleted/suspended account, signup or registration, switching or linking accounts (Facebook, Google, phone number), changing email or password
subtopics.access.security: Hacked or compromised account, unknown devices or people using the account, privacy concerns about account data

usability.definition: Navigation, controls, layout, queue/playlist management, ad interruptions

subtopics.usability.ads: Too many, too long, too loud or repeated ads; ads interrupting listening; the free ad-free-minutes promise not honored (for free users)
subtopics.usability.interface: Layout, redesign, navigation, home feed, cluttered or confusing screens, hard to find things, disliked UI changes (with no premium paywall involved)
subtopics.usability.library_queue: Managing playlists, the queue, liked songs or the library: adding/removing/sorting songs, playlist editing, playlist covers
subtopics.usability.controls: Playback controls and surfaces: shuffle or repeat behaving badly (not a paywall), seek bar, lock screen, notification, widget, sleep timer, car-mode UI, sharing

playback.definition: Playback failure, crashes, lag, connection failures, audio quality, resource use

subtopics.playback.crash: App crashes, force-closes, will not open, black or blank screen
subtopics.playback.interruptions: Music stops or pauses on its own, skips by itself, songs will not play, playback error messages
subtopics.playback.performance: Lag, slow loading, freezing, buffering, unresponsive app
subtopics.playback.devices_connectivity: Bluetooth, car/Android Auto, smart speakers, Spotify Connect, casting, smartwatch/Wear OS, false 'no internet connection' errors
subtopics.playback.audio_quality: Sound quality, volume levels, equalizer, audio glitches or distortion
subtopics.playback.resource_use: Battery drain, overheating, storage, mobile data use, app size

downloads.definition: Downloading, saved music, offline listening, disappearing downloads

subtopics.downloads.failure: Downloads fail, get stuck, are slow or will not start
subtopics.downloads.lost: Downloaded music disappears, gets deleted or must be downloaded again
subtopics.downloads.offline: Offline mode or offline playback not working, offline limits

catalog.definition: Missing songs/artists, search/discovery, recommendations, lyrics availability

subtopics.catalog.unavailable: Songs, artists or albums missing, removed, greyed out, region-locked or wrong version
subtopics.catalog.search: Search does not find content or gives poor results
subtopics.catalog.recommendations: Recommendations, autoplay or radio picks, songs suggested or inserted into playlists, the algorithm, smart shuffle, DJ, Wrapped
subtopics.catalog.lyrics: Lyrics missing, wrong, out of sync or not loading (lyrics locked behind Premium is billing)
subtopics.catalog.podcasts_audiobooks: Podcast or audiobook content and availability, too much podcast/audiobook promotion
subtopics.catalog.other: Any other catalog or content problem

billing.definition: Price, charges, subscriptions, paywalls, premium entitlement; explicitly premium-only controls go here

subtopics.billing.free_tier_limits: Features locked behind Premium for free users: cannot choose specific songs, forced shuffle, skip limits, no repeat or seeking, lyrics or downloads only for Premium, 'everything needs premium'
subtopics.billing.price: Price too high, price increases, regional pricing, poor value for money
subtopics.billing.charges: Unexpected, unauthorized or double charges, charged after cancelling, refunds, cannot cancel a subscription
subtopics.billing.entitlement: Paid Premium not activating or not working, still getting ads or limits while paying, Family/Duo/Student plan problems, payment method failures, trial problems

support.definition: Contacting support and the support response

subtopics.support.contact: No way to reach support, no response, slow response
subtopics.support.resolution: Unhelpful answers, bots, support did not resolve the issue

other.definition: General praise/criticism, unrelated content, or no supported specific topic

subtopics.other.general: General praise or general criticism with no specific feature or problem (for example 'good app', 'worst app', 'love it', 'new update is bad')
subtopics.other.unclear: Meaningless, unrelated to the app, unintelligible, bare boycott or political slogans, spam

intents.cancellation: Explicitly leaving, uninstalling, cancelling, switching to another app, or threatening to do so
intents.complaint: A negative experience, including mixed praise and criticism
intents.request: A desired change or feature, without a reported failure
intents.unclear: Neutral, unrelated, meaningless or uninterpretable text; bare boycott slogans

severity.1: No reported problem: praise, neutral/unclear content, or a pure feature request
severity.2: Dislike, generic criticism, minor annoyance, or a cosmetic issue; no supported functional loss
severity.3: A degraded or restricted function; some use or workaround remains
severity.4: A clearly blocked core task, such as inability to log in or play music
severity.5: Explicit serious financial, privacy, or data harm; an expensive plan, a crash, or angry language alone is insufficient
